name: echocat-skill-panel-3.0
description: Per-turn skill audit for DeepSeek Harness, plus an in-app skill manager: a native notification and a resident panel showing which skills each turn invoked, an install sheet that adds, replaces and removes skills without leaving the app, and per-skill provenance so an installed skill can be checked for and pulled up to its author's latest revision.
